 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anish Dayal

This bail application is filed seeking regular bail in FIR No. 224/2010 under Sections 376(2)(g)/342/506 IPC r/w 34 IPC registered at PS Govind Puri.
2. It is noted that prosecutrix has not been able to be served since she was not found at the address that was noted earlier.
The IO has taken steps to trace the prosecutrix but to no avail, as yet.
3. Further steps be taken to trace the prosecutrix in order that she is served for the next date.

4. Matter is listed for regular suspension of sentence filed in appeal filed against conviction by judgment dated 30th August 2019 and order on sentence dated 07th September 2019 where the appellant has been awarded 20 years RI with fine.
